questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Indus Valley Civilization (IVC): 
(a) The Harappans were the first to produce cotton in the world.
(b) Iron was extensively used for making agricultural tools in Harappa.
(c) Evidence of a dockyard has been found in Lothal.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Harappans produced cotton (called 'Sindon' by Greeks), but they were not aware of Iron; Iron was introduced in the Later Vedic period. Lothal was a prominent port city.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
हड़प्पावासियों ने कपास का उत्पादन किया (यूनानियों द्वारा 'सिंडन' कहा गया), लेकिन वे लोहे से परिचित नहीं थे; लोहे की शुरुआत उत्तर वैदिक काल में हुई थी। लोथल एक प्रमुख बंदरगाह शहर था।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the Battle of Hydaspes is correct?

options.a: It was fought between Alexander and Chandragupta Maurya.
options.b: It took place on the banks of the Ravi River.
options.c: King Porus was defeated but his kingdom was restored by Alexander.
options.d: It led to the immediate end of the Nanda Dynasty.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Battle of Hydaspes (326 BC) was fought between Alexander and Porus on the banks of the Jhelum (Hydaspes). Impressed by Porus's bravery, Alexander returned his kingdom.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
हाइडेस्पस का युद्ध (326 ईसा पूर्व) झेलम (हाइडेस्पस) के तट पर सिकंदर और पोरस के बीच लड़ा गया था। पोरस की बहादुरी से प्रभावित होकर सिकंदर ने उसका राज्य वापस कर दिया।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Ashoka’s Dhamma: 
(a) It was a new religion founded to replace Buddhism.
(b) It emphasized tolerance, non-violence, and respect for elders.
(c) Ashoka appointed 'Dhamma Mahamattas' to spread its principles.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Ashoka’s Dhamma was not a new religion but a code of conduct and social ethics. He appointed officials called Dhamma Mahamattas to propagate these values.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अशोक का धम्म कोई नया धर्म नहीं था बल्कि एक आचार संहिता और सामाजिक नैतिकता थी। उन्होंने इन मूल्यों के प्रचार के लिए धम्म महामत्त नामक अधिकारियों की नियुक्ति की।

questions.question: The 'Allahabad Pillar Inscription' (Prayag Prashasti) provides information about the reign of:
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Composed by Harisena, the Prayag Prashasti describes the conquests and personality of Samudragupta, often called the 'Napoleon of India'.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
हरिषेण द्वारा रचित प्रयाग प्रशस्ति समुद्रगुप्त की विजयों और व्यक्तित्व का वर्णन करती है, जिन्हें अक्सर 'भारत का नेपोलियन' कहा जाता है।

questions.question:
Consider the following pairs of Delhi Sultanate officials and their departments: 
(a) Diwan-i-Arz : Military Department
(b) Diwan-i-Kohi : Agriculture Department
(c) Diwan-i-Khairat : Department of Slave
 Which of the pairs given above is/are correctly matched?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Diwan-i-Arz was created by Balban, Diwan-i-Kohi by MBT. Diwan-i-Khairat was the department of charity (not slaves) created by Firoz Shah Tughlaq.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
दीवान-ए-अर्ज़ बलबन द्वारा, दीवान-ए-कोही MBT द्वारा बनाया गया था। दीवान-ए-खैरात फिरोज शाह तुगलक द्वारा बनाया गया दान विभाग (दासों का नहीं) था।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the 'Iqtadari System' is incorrect?

options.a: It was introduced in India by Iltutmish.
options.b: It was a hereditary land ownership system.
options.c: The Iqtadars were responsible for maintaining law and order.
options.d: They used their revenue to maintain a military contingent.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Initially, Iqtadari was not hereditary; it was a grant of revenue from a territory in lieu of salary. It became hereditary later during Firoz Shah Tughlaq's reign.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
प्रारंभ में, इक्तादारी वंशानुगत नहीं थी; यह वेतन के बदले किसी क्षेत्र से राजस्व का अनुदान था। फिरोज शाह तुगलक के शासनकाल के दौरान यह वंशानुगत हो गई।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Battle of Talikota (1565): 
(a) It led to the downfall of the Vijayanagara Empire.
(b) It was fought between Vijayanagara and the combined forces of Deccan Sultanates.
(c) Krishnadevaraya led the Vijayanagara army in this battle.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The battle was fought in 1565. Rama Raya led the army, not Krishnadevaraya (who died in 1529). The Deccan alliance (except Berar) defeated Vijayanagara.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
यह युद्ध 1565 में लड़ा गया था। राम राय ने सेना का नेतृत्व किया था, न कि कृष्णदेवराय ने (जिनकी मृत्यु 1529 में हुई थी)। दक्कन गठबंधन (बरार को छोड़कर) ने विजयनगर को हराया था।

questions.question: Which Mughal Emperor prohibited the use of Tobacco?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Tobacco was introduced by the Portuguese during Akbar's reign, but his son Jahangir prohibited its use in 1617 due to its harmful effects.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अकबर के शासनकाल के दौरान पुर्तगालियों द्वारा तंबाकू लाया गया था, लेकिन उसके बेटे जहाँगीर ने 1617 में इसके हानिकारक प्रभावों के कारण इसके उपयोग पर प्रतिबंध लगा दिया था।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the Subsidiary Alliance system: 
(a) It was framed by Lord Dalhousie.
(b) The ruler had to maintain a British force within their territory.
(c) Hyderabad was the first state to accept this alliance.
 Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Subsidiary Alliance was framed by Lord Wellesley (not Dalhousie). Hyderabad (1798) was indeed the first to sign it.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सहायक संधि लॉर्ड वेलेज़ली (डलहौजी नहीं) द्वारा तैयार की गई थी। हैदराबाद (1798) वास्तव में इस पर हस्ताक्षर करने वाला पहला राज्य था।

questions.question:
With reference to the Permanent Settlement of 1793, consider the following statements: 
(a) It was introduced by Lord Cornwallis in Bengal and Bihar.
(b) The Zamindars were made the owners of the land.
(c) The share of the government was fixed at 1/3rd of the total produce.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The government's share was fixed at 10/11th of the rent collected by Zamindars, not 1/3rd of the produce. It gave ownership rights to Zamindars as long as they paid the fixed revenue.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सरकार का हिस्सा जमींदारों द्वारा वसूले गए किराए का 10/11 तय किया गया था, न कि उपज का 1/3। इसने जमींदारों को तब तक स्वामित्व अधिकार दिए जब तक वे निश्चित राजस्व का भुगतान करते रहे।

questions.question: Which of the following statements is correct regarding the Morley-Minto Reforms of 1909?

options.a: It introduced a bicameral legislature at the center.
options.b: It provided for separate electorates for Muslims.
options.c: It granted the right to vote to all women.
options.d: It was based on the recommendations of the Simon Commission.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The 1909 Act introduced communal representation by providing separate electorates for Muslims, earning Lord Minto the title 'Father of Communal Electorate'.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
1909 के अधिनियम ने मुसलमानों के लिए अलग निर्वाचन क्षेत्र प्रदान करके सांप्रदायिक प्रतिनिधित्व की शुरुआत की, जिससे लॉर्ड मिंटो को 'सांप्रदायिक निर्वाचन क्षेत्र के जनक' की उपाधि मिली।

questions.question:
Consider the following events of the Indian National Movement: 
(a) Rowlatt Satyagraha
(b) Jallianwala Bagh Massacre
(c) Khilafat Movement
(d) Non-Cooperation Movement
 What is the correct chronological order of these events?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Rowlatt Satyagraha (April 6, 1919), Jallianwala Bagh (April 13, 1919), Khilafat Movement (Late 1919), Non-Cooperation Movement (1920).

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
रॉलेट सत्याग्रह (6 अप्रैल, 1919), जलियांवाला बाग (13 अप्रैल, 1919), खिलाफत आंदोलन (1919 के अंत में), असहयोग आंदोलन (1920)।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the Gandhi-Irwin Pact (1931) is incorrect?

options.a: Congress agreed to suspend the Civil Disobedience Movement.
options.b: The British agreed to release all political prisoners including those involved in violence.
options.c: Gandhiji agreed to participate in the Second Round Table Conference.
options.d: It allowed the manufacture of salt for personal consumption in coastal villages.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The British agreed to release only those political prisoners who were NOT convicted of violence. This was a major point of contention regarding Bhagat Singh's execution.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अंग्रेज केवल उन्हीं राजनीतिक बंदियों को रिहा करने पर सहमत हुए जो हिंसा के दोषी नहीं थे। भगत सिंह की फांसी के संबंध में यह विवाद का एक प्रमुख बिंदु था।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the revolt of 1857: 
(a) Begum Hazrat Mahal led the revolt in Lucknow.
(b) Lord Canning was the Governor-General during the revolt.
(c) The revolt was supported by the educated middle class of India.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The educated middle class and many Indian rulers remained neutral or supported the British. They viewed the revolt as backward-looking.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
शिक्षित मध्यम वर्ग और कई भारतीय शासक तटस्थ रहे या अंग्रेजों का समर्थन किया। उन्होंने विद्रोह को पिछड़ी सोच वाला माना।

questions.question: Who was the President of the Haripura Session (1938) of the Indian National Congress?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Subhas Chandra Bose was elected President at the Haripura session in 1938. He also won at Tripuri (1939) but resigned due to differences with Gandhi.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सुभाष चंद्र बोस 1938 में हरिपुरा अधिवेशन में अध्यक्ष चुने गए थे। उन्होंने त्रिपुरी (1939) में भी जीत हासिल की लेकिन गांधी के साथ मतभेदों के कारण इस्तीफा दे दिया।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Vedic Society: 
(a) In the Early Vedic period, kingship was not hereditary.
(b) 'Saba' and 'Samiti' were the popular assemblies that exercised control over the king. / '
(c) Women were not allowed to attend the 'Saba' or 'Vidatha'.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
In the Early Vedic period, women participated in 'Saba' and 'Vidatha'. Their status declined in the Later Vedic period when they were restricted from attending these assemblies.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
ऋग्वैदिक काल में महिलाएँ 'सभा' और 'विदथ' में भाग लेती थीं। उत्तर वैदिक काल में उनकी स्थिति में गिरावट आई जब उन्हें इन सभाओं में भाग लेने से रोक दिया गया।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the 'Din-i-Ilahi' is incorrect? '

options.a: It was introduced by Akbar in 1582.
options.b: It was a synthesis of multiple religions like Islam, Hinduism, and Jainism.
options.c: It had its own priesthood and a holy book.
options.d: Birbal was the only Hindu to accept it.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Din-i-Ilahi did not have a priesthood or a holy book. It was more of an ethical code of conduct for the nobility rather than a formal religion.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
दीन-ए-इलाही में कोई पुरोहित वर्ग या पवित्र पुस्तक नहीं थी। यह एक औपचारिक धर्म के बजाय रईसों के लिए एक नैतिक आचार संहिता अधिक थी।

questions.question:
Consider the following pairs of travelers and the rulers during whose reign they visited India: 
(a) Megasthenes : Chandragupta Maurya
(b) Fa-Hien : Chandragupta II
(c) Hiuen Tsang : Harshavardhana
 Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
All pairs are correctly matched. Megasthenes was a Greek ambassador, while Fa-Hien and Hiuen Tsang were Chinese Buddhist pilgrims.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सभी युग्म सही सुमेलित हैं। मेगास्थनीज एक यूनानी राजदूत थे, जबकि फाह्यान और ह्वेनसांग चीनी बौद्ध तीर्थयात्री थे।

questions.question:
With reference to the 'Iltutmish', consider the following statements: 
(a) He introduced the silver coin 'Tanka' and copper coin 'Jital'.
(b) He completed the construction of the Qutub Minar.
(c) He organized a group of 40 loyal slaves known as 'Turkan-i-Chahalgani'.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Iltutmish is considered the real founder of the Delhi Sultanate. He consolidated the empire through administrative and monetary reforms.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
इल्तुतमिश को दिल्ली सल्तनत का वास्तविक संस्थापक माना जाता है। उसने प्रशासनिक और मौद्रिक सुधारों के माध्यम से साम्राज्य को मजबूत किया।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the 'Government of India Act 1935' is correct?

options.a: It introduced Diarchy at the provincial level.
options.b: It abolished Diarchy at the center.
options.c: It provided for the establishment of a Federal Court.
options.d: It separated Burma from India in 1947.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The 1935 Act abolished provincial diarchy and introduced provincial autonomy. It introduced diarchy at the Center and established the Federal Court (1937) and RBI. Burma was separated in 1937.
1935

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
के अधिनियम ने प्रांतीय द्वैध शासन को समाप्त कर दिया और प्रांतीय स्वायत्तता की शुरुआत की। इसने केंद्र में द्वैध शासन की शुरुआत की और संघीय न्यायालय (1937) और RBI की स्थापना की। बर्मा 1937 में अलग हुआ था।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Cabinet Mission' (1946): 
(a) It recommended a weak center with powers limited to Foreign Affairs, Defense, and Communications.
(b) It rejected the demand for a full-fledged Pakistan.
(c) It suggested the formation of a Constituent Assembly.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Cabinet Mission (Pethick-Lawrence, Stafford Cripps, A.V. Alexander) aimed to keep India united while giving autonomy to provinces grouped into three sections.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
कैबिनेट मिशन (पेथिक-लॉरेंस, स्टैफोर्ड क्रिप्स, ए.वी. अलेक्जेंडर) का उद्देश्य भारत को एकजुट रखना था, जबकि तीन वर्गों में समूहों में विभाजित प्रांतों को स्वायत्तता देना था।

questions.question: In the context of Modern History, what was the 'Comagata Maru'?

options.b: A Japanese steamship carrying Indian immigrants to Canada
options.c: A secret society formed in London
options.d: A newspaper started by Lala Hardayal

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Komagata Maru was a Japanese ship chartered by Gurdit Singh in 1914 to transport 376 Indians to Canada. They were forced to return, leading to a clash at Budge Budge (Kolkata).

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
कोमागाटा मारू एक जापानी जहाज था जिसे 1914 में गुरदित सिंह द्वारा 376 भारतीयों को कनाडा ले जाने के लिए किराए पर लिया गया था। उन्हें वापस लौटने के लिए मजबूर किया गया, जिससे बज बज (कोलकाता) में झड़प हुई।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the 'Bhakti Movement': 
(a) Alvars were the devotees of Lord Shiva.
(b) Nayanars were the devotees of Lord Vishnu.
(c) It emphasized personal devotion to God over ritualism.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Alvars were Vishnu devotees and Nayanars were Shiva devotees. They originated in South India (Tamil Nadu) around the 7th-9th century.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अलवार विष्णु भक्त थे और नयनार शिव भक्त थे। उनकी उत्पत्ति 7वीं-9वीं शताब्दी के आसपास दक्षिण भारत (तमिलनाडु) में हुई थी।

questions.question: Which of the following was the immediate cause for the launch of the Swadeshi Movement?

options.a: The partition of Bengal by Lord Curzon.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Swadeshi Movement was a direct reaction to the partition of Bengal (1905), which Curzon claimed was for administrative convenience but was actually to curb Indian nationalism.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
स्वदेशी आंदोलन बंगाल के विभाजन (1905) की प्रत्यक्ष प्रतिक्रिया थी, जिसे कर्जन ने प्रशासनिक सुविधा के लिए बताया था लेकिन वास्तव में यह भारतीय राष्ट्रवाद को रोकने के लिए था।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the 'Ryotwari System': 
(a) It was introduced by Thomas Munro and Alexander Reed.
(b) It was primarily implemented in the Madras and Bombay Presidencies.
(c) The ownership of land was given to the village community as a whole.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
In Ryotwari, the ownership was given directly to the individual cultivators (Ryots). The Mahalwari system gave ownership to the village community.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
रैयतवाड़ी में, स्वामित्व सीधे व्यक्तिगत खेती करने वालों (रैयतों) को दिया गया था। महलवाड़ी व्यवस्था में ग्राम समुदाय को स्वामित्व दिया गया था।

questions.question: The 'Sadaqat Ashram' in Patna was established by which national leader?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Mazharul Haque established the Sadaqat Ashram in 1921 during the Non-Cooperation Movement. It later became the residence of Dr. Rajendra Prasad after his retirement.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मजहरुल हक ने 1921 में असहयोग आंदोलन के दौरान सदाकत आश्रम की स्थापना की थी। यह बाद में अपनी सेवानिवृत्ति के बाद डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद का निवास स्थान बना।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Third Buddhist Council': 
(a) It was held at Pataliputra during the reign of Ashoka.
(b) It was presided over by Moggaliputta Tissa.
(c) The 'Abhidhamma Pitaka' was compiled during this council.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The 3rd Council (approx. 250 BC) focused on purging the Sangha of corruption and led to the compilation of the 3rd basket of Buddhist scriptures, the Abhidhamma Pitaka.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
तीसरी संगीति (लगभग 250 ईसा पूर्व) संघ को भ्रष्टाचार से मुक्त करने पर केंद्रित थी और इसके परिणामस्वरूप बौद्ध धर्मग्रंथों की तीसरी टोकरी, अभिधम्म पिटक का संकलन हुआ।

questions.question: The 'Silver Tanka' was replaced by 'Token Currency' (Copper/Brass coins) by which Sultan?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Muhammad bin Tughlaq introduced token currency in 1329-30. However, the experiment failed as he could not prevent illegal private minting of coins.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मुहम्मद बिन तुगलक ने 1329-30 में सांकेतिक मुद्रा पेश की। हालाँकि, यह प्रयोग विफल रहा क्योंकि वह सिक्कों की अवैध निजी ढलाई को नहीं रोक सका।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the 'Hindustan Socialist Republican Association' (HSRA): 
(a) It was founded in 1928 at Feroz Shah Kotla, Delhi.
(b) Chandrashekhar Azad and Bhagat Singh were its prominent leaders.
(c) Its objective was to establish a federal republic based on socialist principles.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
HRA (founded in 1924) was renamed HSRA in 1928 under the leadership of Azad and Bhagat Singh, incorporating 'Socialist' into its name and ideology.
HRA (1924

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
में स्थापित) का नाम 1928 में आज़ाद और भगत सिंह के नेतृत्व में बदलकर HSRA कर दिया गया, जिसके नाम और विचारधारा में 'समाजवादी' शब्द जोड़ा गया।

questions.question: Which of the following was the main reason for the 'Akali Movement' in the 1920s?

options.a: To demand a separate state for Sikhs.
options.b: To liberate Gurudwaras from the control of corrupt Mahants.
options.c: To support the British during World War I.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Akali Movement (1920-25) was a non-violent struggle to reform the management of Gurdwaras. It led to the passing of the Sikh Gurdwaras Act, 1925.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अकाली आंदोलन (1920-25) गुरुद्वारों के प्रबंधन में सुधार के लिए एक अहिंसक संघर्ष था। इसके कारण सिख गुरुद्वारा अधिनियम, 1925 पारित किया गया।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Mansabdari System': 
(a) It was introduced by Akbar to organize the nobility and the army.
(b) 'Zat' indicated the number of cavalrymen a Mansabdar had to maintain. / '
(c) 'Sawar' determined the personal status and salary of the Mansabdar. / '
 Which of the above statements is/are incorrect?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The definitions are interchanged. 'Zat' fixed the personal status and salary, while 'Sawar' indicated the number of cavalrymen (rank) to be maintained.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
परिभाषाएँ आपस में बदल दी गई हैं। 'ज़ात' ने व्यक्तिगत स्थिति और वेतन तय किया, जबकि 'सवार' ने बनाए रखे जाने वाले घुड़सवारों (रैंक) की संख्या का संकेत दिया।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the 'Chola Administration' is correct?

options.a: It was highly centralized with no local autonomy.
options.b: The 'Ur' was a common assembly of the tax-paying residents. / '
options.c: The 'Sabha' or 'Mahasabha' consisted of all adult males of the village. / '
options.d: Land revenue was collected in cash only.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Chola administration is famous for its village autonomy. 'Ur' was a general assembly, while 'Sabha' was an assembly of learned Brahmins (Agraharas). Revenue was collected in cash or kind.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
चोल प्रशासन अपनी ग्राम स्वायत्तता के लिए प्रसिद्ध है। 'उर' एक सामान्य सभा थी, जबकि 'सभा' विद्वान ब्राह्मणों (अग्रहारों) की सभा थी। राजस्व नकद या वस्तु के रूप में एकत्र किया जाता था।

questions.question:
Consider the following pairs of Maratha taxes: 
(a) Chauth : 1/4th of the land revenue paid to avoid Maratha raids.
(b) Sardeshmukhi : An additional 10% tax claimed as the hereditary overlord.
Which of the pairs given above is/are correctly matched?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Both were key revenue sources for Shivaji. Chauth was protection money from non-Maratha lands, while Sardeshmukhi was a levy on the basis of being the head of the Deshmukhs.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
शिवाजी के लिए दोनों ही राजस्व के प्रमुख स्रोत थे। चौथ गैर-मराठा भूमि से सुरक्षा राशि थी, जबकि सरदेशमुखी देशमुखों का प्रमुख होने के आधार पर एक लेवी थी।

questions.question: The 'Young Bengal Movement' was started by:
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Derozio, a teacher at Hindu College, inspired his students to think freely and question authority. His followers were known as Derozians.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
हिंदू कॉलेज के शिक्षक डेरोजियो ने अपने छात्रों को स्वतंत्र रूप से सोचने और अधिकार पर सवाल उठाने के लिए प्रेरित किया। उनके अनुयायियों को 'डेरोज़ियन' के रूप में जाना जाता था।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Santhal Rebellion' (1855-56): 
(a) It was led by Sidhu and Kanhu.
(b) It occurred in the Rajmahal hills region (Damin-i-Koh).
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Santhal rebellion was a major tribal uprising against the oppression of Zamindars, moneylenders (Dikus), and the British.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
संथाल विद्रोह जमींदारों, साहूकारों (दिकु) और अंग्रेजों के उत्पीड़न के खिलाफ एक प्रमुख आदिवासी विद्रोह था।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the 'Inland Emigration Act of 1859' is correct?

options.a: It allowed plantation workers to return home whenever they wanted.
options.b: It prohibited plantation workers from leaving the tea gardens without permission.
options.c: It was passed to improve the living conditions of labourers.
options.d: It gave workers the right to form unions.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
This act essentially turned tea plantation workers into bonded laborers, as permission to leave was rarely granted. This was a major grievance during the Non-Cooperation Movement.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
इस अधिनियम ने अनिवार्य रूप से चाय बागान श्रमिकों को बंधुआ मजदूरों में बदल दिया, क्योंकि छोड़ने की अनुमति बहुत कम दी जाती थी। असहयोग आंदोलन के दौरान यह एक बड़ी शिकायत थी।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the 'Cabinet Mission' (1946): 
(a) It proposed a three-tier structure of the administration.
(b) It rejected the demand for a separate Pakistan.
(c) It was headed by Lord Pethick-Lawrence.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Cabinet Mission arrived in March 1946. It aimed at formulating a plan for the transfer of power and creating a Constituent Assembly while maintaining the unity of India.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
कैबिनेट मिशन मार्च 1946 में आया था। इसका उद्देश्य सत्ता के हस्तांतरण के लिए एक योजना तैयार करना और भारत की एकता को बनाए रखते हुए एक संविधान सभा बनाना था।

questions.question: In the context of Ancient India, 'Agrahara' refers to:

options.c: A type of tax on trade

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Agrahara was land (often tax-free) granted to Brahmanas for their maintenance, usually by kings or wealthy patrons.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अग्रहार ब्राह्मणों को उनके रखरखाव के लिए (अक्सर कर-मुक्त) दी जाने वाली भूमि थी, जो आमतौर पर राजाओं या धनी संरक्षकों द्वारा दी जाती थी।

questions.question:
Consider the following pairs of Mughal officers and their duties: 
(a) Mir Bakshi : Head of the Military Department
(b) Mir Saman : In charge of the Imperial Household
(c) Muhtasib : Enforcer of public morals
 Which of the above are correctly matched?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
All positions were vital for Mughal administration. Mir Bakshi supervised the Mansabdari system and military recruitment.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मुगल प्रशासन के लिए सभी पद महत्वपूर्ण थे। मीर बख्शी ने मनसबदारी प्रणाली और सैन्य भर्ती की देखरेख की।

questions.question: Which of the following events happened first?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Kakori Train Action (Aug 1925), Simon Commission arrival (Feb 1928), Nehru Report (Aug 1928), Bardoli Satyagraha (1928 - led by Sardar Patel).

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
काकोरी ट्रेन एक्शन (अगस्त 1925), साइमन कमीशन का आगमन (फरवरी 1928), नेहरू रिपोर्ट (अगस्त 1928), बारदोली सत्याग्रह (1928 - सरदार पटेल के नेतृत्व में)।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about 'Jainism': 
(a) Vardhamana Mahavira was the 24th Tirthankara.
(b) Jainism recognized the existence of God but placed him lower than Jina.
(c) It strictly prohibited agricultural practices to avoid harming insects.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Jainism’s extreme focus on Ahimsa led to the prohibition of farming for its monks and followers, as ploughing might kill living organisms in the soil.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अहिंसा पर जैन धर्म के अत्यधिक ध्यान के कारण इसके भिक्षुओं और अनुयायियों के लिए खेती करना प्रतिबंधित हो गया, क्योंकि हल चलाने से मिट्टी में रहने वाले जीव मर सकते थे।

questions.question: Who among the following was the founder of the 'Servants of India Society'?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Gopal Krishna Gokhale founded it in 1905 to train Indians for social service and to promote national interests through peaceful means.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
गोपाल कृष्ण गोखले ने 1905 में भारतीयों को समाज सेवा के लिए प्रशिक्षित करने और शांतिपूर्ण माध्यमों से राष्ट्रीय हितों को बढ़ावा देने के लिए इसकी स्थापना की थी।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Quit India Movement' (1942): 
(a) Gandhiji gave the slogan 'Do or Die'.
(b) The movement was supported by the Muslim League and Hindu Mahasabha.
(c) Parallel governments were formed in places like Balia and Tamluk.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Muslim League, Hindu Mahasabha, and Communist Party did not support the Quit India Movement.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मुस्लिम लीग, हिंदू महासभा और कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी ने भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन का समर्थन नहीं किया।

questions.question: The 'Wavell Plan' was presented in the year:
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Lord Wavell proposed this plan at the Shimla Conference in 1945 to resolve the political deadlock between the Congress and the Muslim League.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
लॉर्ड वेवेल ने कांग्रेस और मुस्लिम लीग के बीच राजनीतिक गतिरोध को दूर करने के लिए 1945 में शिमला सम्मेलन में यह योजना प्रस्तावित की थी।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the 'Ghadar Party' is incorrect?

options.a: It was founded in San Francisco in 1913.
options.b: Lala Hardayal was one of its primary founders.
options.c: It was strictly a pacifist movement.
options.d: Its objective was to overthrow British rule in India through an armed revolt.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Ghadar Party was a revolutionary militant organization, not a pacifist one. It aimed to incite a rebellion among Indian soldiers in the British army.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
गदर पार्टी एक क्रांतिकारी उग्रवादी संगठन था, न कि शांतिवादी। इसका उद्देश्य ब्रिटिश सेना में भारतीय सैनिकों के बीच विद्रोह भड़काना था।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Ilbert Bill' controversy: 
(a) It was introduced during the viceroyalty of Lord Ripon.
(b) It aimed to allow Indian magistrates to try Europeans in criminal cases.
(c) The bill was supported by the European community in India.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The European community fiercely opposed the bill, viewing it as a challenge to their racial superiority. This led to the withdrawal of the original bill.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
यूरोपीय समुदाय ने इस बिल का कड़ा विरोध किया, क्योंकि वे इसे अपनी नस्लीय श्रेष्ठता के लिए एक चुनौती मानते थे। इसके कारण मूल बिल वापस ले लिया गया था।

questions.question: Which of the following pairs of 'Mahajanapadas' and their capitals is incorrectly matched?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The capital of Matsya Mahajanapada was Viratanagara. Mathura was the capital of the Surasena Mahajanapada.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मत्स्य महाजनपद की राजधानी विराटनगर थी। मथुरा शूरसेन महाजनपद की राजधानी थी।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the 'Prarthana Samaj': 
(a) It was founded by Atmaram Pandurang in Bombay.
(b) It was heavily influenced by the Brahmo Samaj.
(c) It rejected the Vedas and Upanishads completely.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Prarthana Samaj (1867) sought to reform Hindu religious practice based on monotheism and drew inspiration from ancient texts like the Bhagavad Gita and Upanishads.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
प्रार्थना समाज (1867) ने एकेश्वरवाद के आधार पर हिंदू धार्मिक प्रथाओं में सुधार करने की कोशिश की और भगवद गीता और उपनिषदों जैसे प्राचीन ग्रंथों से प्रेरणा ली।

questions.question:
With reference to 'Sher Shah Suri', consider the following statements: 
(a) He introduced the silver 'Rupia' which remained a standard coin for centuries.
(b) He built the 'Grand Trunk Road' from Sonargaon to Attock.
(c) He defeated Humayun in the Battles of Chausa and Kannauj.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Sher Shah was a brilliant administrator. His currency and road infrastructure provided the foundation for later Mughal and British administrative systems.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
शेर शाह एक शानदार प्रशासक था। उसकी मुद्रा और सड़क के बुनियादी ढांचे ने बाद के मुगल और ब्रिटिश प्रशासनिक प्रणालियों के लिए आधार प्रदान किया।

questions.question: The 'Woods Despatch' of 1854 is related to which of the following?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Known as the 'Magna Carta of English Education in India', it recommended a structured system of education from primary school to university level.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
इसे 'भारत में अंग्रेजी शिक्षा का मैग्ना कार्टा' कहा जाता है, इसने प्राथमिक विद्यालय से विश्वविद्यालय स्तर तक शिक्षा की एक संरचित प्रणाली की सिफारिश की थी।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding 'Buddhism': 
(a) The 'Sutta Pitaka' contains the philosophical interpretations of the Buddha's teachings. / '
(b) The 'Vinaya Pitaka' contains the rules for monks and nuns. / '
(c) The first Buddhist Council was held at Rajgriha immediately after Buddha's death.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
'Abhidhamma Pitaka' contains philosophical interpretations. 'Sutta Pitaka' contains the actual sermons and teachings of the Buddha.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
'अभिधम्म पिटक' में दार्शनिक व्याख्याएँ हैं। 'सुत्त पिटक' में बुद्ध के वास्तविक उपदेश और शिक्षाएं शामिल हैं।

questions.question: Which of the following events occurred during the reign of Lord Lytton?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Lytton's viceroyalty (1876-1880) was marked by reactionary policies that angered Indians, including the restrictive Press Act and Arms Act.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
लिटन का वायसराय काल (1876-1880) प्रतिक्रियावादी नीतियों द्वारा चिह्नित था जिसने भारतीयों को क्रोधित कर दिया, जिसमें प्रतिबंधात्मक प्रेस अधिनियम और शस्त्र अधिनियम शामिल थे।

questions.question:
Consider the following pairs of 'Social Reforms' and their 'Proponents': 
(a) Satyshodhak Samaj : Jyotiba Phule
(b) Self-Respect Movement : E.V. Ramaswamy Naicker
(c) Deva Samaj : Shiv Narayan Agnihotri
 Which of the above are correctly matched?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
All these movements targeted social inequality and sought to reform traditional hierarchies within Indian society.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
इन सभी आंदोलनों ने सामाजिक असमानता को लक्षित किया और भारतीय समाज के भीतर पारंपरिक पदानुक्रमों में सुधार करने की मांग की।

questions.question: Which battle established the British supremacy in India?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
While Plassey gave them a foothold, the Battle of Buxar (where they defeated the combined forces of Mir Qasim, Shuja-ud-Daulah, and Shah Alam II) made them the de facto masters of Bengal, Bihar, and Odisha.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
जबकि प्लासी ने उन्हें पैर जमाने की जगह दी, बक्सर के युद्ध (जहाँ उन्होंने मीर कासिम, शुजा-उद-दौला और शाह आलम द्वितीय की संयुक्त सेनाओं को हराया) ने उन्हें बंगाल, बिहार और ओडिशा का वास्तविक स्वामी बना दिया।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding 'Akbar's Administration': 
(a) The 'Dahsala System' was a system of land revenue assessment based on 10 years' average. / '
(b) Raja Todar Mal was the finance minister responsible for these reforms.
(c) The state took 1/2 of the average produce as revenue.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct? /
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Under the Dahsala/Zabti system, the state's share was usually 1/3rd of the average produce, not 1/2.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
दहसाला/ज़ब्ती प्रणाली के तहत, राज्य का हिस्सा आमतौर पर औसत उपज का 1/3 था, न कि 1/2।

questions.question: Who among the following was the founder of the 'Vikramshila University'?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Dharmapala, the Pala king, founded Vikramshila in response to a supposed decline in the quality of scholarship at Nalanda.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
पाल राजा धर्मपाल ने नालंदा में छात्रवृत्ति की गुणवत्ता में कथित गिरावट के जवाब में विक्रमशिला की स्थापना की थी।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the 'Lucknow Pact' (1916): 
(a) It was a joint agreement between the Indian National Congress and the Muslim League.
(b) The Congress accepted the demand for separate electorates for Muslims.
(c) Bal Gangadhar Tilak and Annie Besant played key roles in this reconciliation.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Lucknow Pact brought Moderates and Extremists together within the Congress and also bridged the gap between the Congress and the Muslim League temporarily.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
लखनऊ समझौते ने कांग्रेस के भीतर नरमपंथियों और चरमपंथियों को एक साथ लाया और कांग्रेस और मुस्लिम लीग के बीच की खाई को अस्थायी रूप से पाट दिया।

questions.question: The 'Drain of Wealth' theory was first propounded by:
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
In his book "Poverty and Un-British Rule in India", Naoroji explained how British policies were siphoning off India's wealth to England.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अपनी पुस्तक "पवर्टी एंड अन-ब्रिटिश रूल इन इंडिया" में, नौरोजी ने समझाया कि कैसे ब्रिटिश नीतियां भारत की संपत्ति को इंग्लैंड की ओर ले जा रही थीं।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding 'Jain Councils': 
(a) The First Jain Council was held at Pataliputra.
(b) The Second Jain Council was held at Vallabhi.
(c) The compilation of 12 'Angas' took place in the first council.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The first council was presided over by Sthulabhadra (300 BC). The final compilation of Jain scriptures occurred at the second council (512 AD) in Vallabhi, Gujarat.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
प्रथम संगीति की अध्यक्षता स्थूलभद्र (300 ईसा पूर्व) ने की थी। जैन धर्मग्रंथों का अंतिम संकलन वल्लभी, गुजरात में दूसरी संगीति (512 ईस्वी) में हुआ था।

questions.question: Which Indian leader was popularly known as 'Deshbandhu'?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Chittaranjan Das (C.R. Das) was a leading figure in the Non-Cooperation movement and the founder of the Swaraj Party. C.F. Andrews was known as 'Deenbandhu'.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
चित्तरंजन दास (सी.आर. दास) असहयोग आंदोलन के एक प्रमुख नेता और स्वराज पार्टी के संस्थापक थे। सी.एफ. एंड्रयूज को 'दीनबंधु' के नाम से जाना जाता था।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Ashtapradhan' of Shivaji: 
(a) The 'Peshwa' was responsible for the general administration. / '
(b) 'Amatya' looked after the accounts and finance. / '
(c) All members of the Ashtapradhan were required to lead military campaigns.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
All members except the 'Panditrao' (High Priest) and 'Nyayadhish' (Chief Justice) were expected to serve in the military and lead campaigns.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
'पंडितराव' (मुख्य पुजारी) और 'न्यायाधीश' (मुख्य न्यायाधीश) को छोड़कर सभी सदस्यों से सेना में सेवा करने और अभियानों का नेतृत्व करने की अपेक्षा की जाती थी।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the 'Pallava Architecture' is correct?

options.a: The Shore Temple at Mahabalipuram was built by Narasimhavarman II.
options.b: The 'Ratha' temples are examples of structural temples. / '
options.c: They introduced the 'Vesara' style of architecture in South India.
options.d: Their temples were primarily built of bricks and wood.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Shore Temple is a structural temple built by Narasimhavarman II (Rajasimha). The 'Rathas' are monolithic (cut from a single rock), not structural. Pallavas pioneered the 'Dravidian' style.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
तट मंदिर एक संरचनात्मक मंदिर है जिसे नरसिंहवर्मन द्वितीय (राजसिंह) द्वारा बनाया गया था। 'रथ' एकाश्म (एक ही चट्टान से कटे हुए) हैं, न कि संरचनात्मक। पल्लवों ने 'द्रविड़' शैली की शुरुआत की थी।

questions.question:
Consider the following events regarding the 'Maratha-British' relations: 
(a) Treaty of Salbai
(b) Treaty of Bassein
(c) Treaty of Purandar
 What is the correct chronological order of these treaties?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Treaty of Purandar (1776 - during 1st Anglo-Maratha War), Treaty of Salbai (1782 - ended 1st war), Treaty of Bassein (1802 - led to 2nd Anglo-Maratha War).

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
पुरंदर की संधि (1776 - प्रथम आंग्ल-मराठा युद्ध के दौरान), सालबाई की संधि (1782 - प्रथम युद्ध समाप्त), बसईन की संधि (1802 - इसके कारण द्वितीय आंग्ल-मराठा युद्ध हुआ)।

questions.question:
With reference to the 'Sangam Age', consider the following statements: 
(a) The Sangam literature was composed in the Sanskrit language.
(b) The 'Cheras', 'Cholas', and 'Pandyas' were the three major dynasties of this period. / '
(c) The first Sangam was held at Madurai under the chairmanship of Agastya.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Sangam literature was composed in Tamil (not Sanskrit). It provides a rich account of the social and political life of South India during that era.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
संगम साहित्य की रचना तमिल (संस्कृत नहीं) में की गई थी। यह उस युग के दौरान दक्षिण भारत के सामाजिक और राजनीतिक जीवन का समृद्ध विवरण प्रदान करता है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about 'Raja Ram Mohan Roy' is incorrect?

options.c: He supported the introduction of English education in India.
options.d: He was against the abolition of the Sati system.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Raja Ram Mohan Roy was the primary campaigner against Sati, which led to its legal abolition by Lord William Bentinck in 1829.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
राजा राम मोहन राय सती प्रथा के खिलाफ प्राथमिक अभियानकर्ता थे, जिसके परिणामस्वरूप 1829 में लॉर्ड विलियम बेंटिक द्वारा इसका कानूनी उन्मूलन किया गया।

questions.question:
Consider the following pairs of 'Ancient Ports' and their locations: 
(a) Muziris : Kerala Coast
(b) Tamralipti : Bengal Coast
(c) Arikamedu : Coromandel Coast
 Which of the above pairs are correctly matched?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
These were vital trade centers. Arikamedu was famous for its trade with the Roman Empire, and Tamralipti was the main port for trade with Southeast Asia.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
ये महत्वपूर्ण व्यापारिक केंद्र थे। अरिकामेडु रोमन साम्राज्य के साथ अपने व्यापार के लिए प्रसिद्ध था, और ताम्रलिप्ति दक्षिण-पूर्व एशिया के साथ व्यापार का मुख्य बंदरगाह था।

questions.question: The 'August Offer' (1940) was proposed by which Viceroy?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
To seek Indian cooperation in World War II, Linlithgow promised 'Dominion Status' and the expansion of the Viceroy's Executive Council.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध में भारतीय सहयोग प्राप्त करने के लिए, लिनलिथगो ने 'डोमिनियन स्टेटस' और वायसराय की कार्यकारी परिषद के विस्तार का वादा किया था।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Indian National Army' (INA): 
(a) It was first conceived by Mohan Singh.
(b) Subhas Chandra Bose took over its leadership in Singapore.
(c) The 'Rani Jhansi Regiment' was a women's unit within the INA. / '
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
INA was formed with the help of Japanese forces. Its trials at the Red Fort in 1945 sparked massive nationalistic fervour across India.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
INA का गठन जापानी सेना की मदद से किया गया था। 1945 में लाल किले में इसके मुकदमों ने पूरे भारत में भारी राष्ट्रवादी जोश पैदा कर दिया था।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the 'Surat Split' (1907) is correct?

options.a: It occurred due to differences between Moderates and Extremists over the Swadeshi Movement.
options.b: Ras Bihari Ghosh presided over the Surat session.
options.c: The Extremists wanted the movement to be confined to Bengal only.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Extremists (Lal-Bal-Pal) wanted to expand Swadeshi pan-India, while Moderates wanted to limit it to Bengal. This ideological clash led to the split.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
चरमपंथी (लाल-बाल-पाल) स्वदेशी को अखिल भारतीय स्तर पर विस्तारित करना चाहते थे, जबकि नरमपंथी इसे बंगाल तक सीमित रखना चाहते थे। इसी वैचारिक टकराव के कारण विभाजन हुआ।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about the 'Delhi Sultanate' architecture: 
(a) The 'Alai Darwaza' was built by Alauddin Khalji using red sandstone. / '
(b) The 'True Arch' was introduced in India by the Turks.
(c) Tughlaq architecture is characterized by sloping walls (Batter).
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Sultanate architecture blended Indian and Islamic styles (Indo-Islamic). The use of arch, dome, and mortar were significant contributions.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सल्तनत वास्तुकला ने भारतीय और इस्लामी शैलियों (इंडो-इस्लामिक) का मिश्रण किया। मेहराब, गुंबद और गारे (mortar) का उपयोग महत्वपूर्ण योगदान था।

questions.question: Who was the first Indian woman to become the President of the Indian National Congress?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Sarojini Naidu presided over the Kanpur session in 1925. Annie Besant was the first woman (1917), but she was not Indian.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सरोजिनी नायडू ने 1925 में कानपुर अधिवेशन की अध्यक्षता की थी। एनी बेसेंट पहली महिला (1917) थीं, लेकिन वे भारतीय नहीं थीं।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the 'Gupta Empire':
(a) Fa-Hien visited India during the reign of Chandragupta II.
(b) Gold coins issued by Guptas were known as 'Dinars'.
(c) The practice of 'Sati' is mentioned for the first time in the Eran inscription. / '
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The Gupta period is often called the 'Golden Age' of India. The Eran inscription (510 AD) provides the first epigraphical evidence of Sati.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
गुप्त काल को अक्सर भारत का 'स्वर्ण युग' कहा जाता है। एरण शिलालेख (510 ईस्वी) सती प्रथा का पहला अभिलेखीय साक्ष्य प्रदान करता है।

questions.question: Which of the following was NOT a member of the 'Swaraj Party'?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Sardar Patel was a 'No-changer' who believed in constructive work and opposed entering the legislative councils. Swarajists (Pro-changers) wanted to enter councils to "wreck the government from within."

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सरदार पटेल एक 'परिवर्तन-विरोधी' (No-changer) थे जो रचनात्मक कार्य में विश्वास करते थे और विधायी परिषदों में प्रवेश का विरोध करते थे। स्वराजवादी (परिवर्तनवादी) "भीतर से सरकार को नष्ट करने" के लिए परिषदों में प्रवेश करना चाहते थे।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about 'Mahatma Gandhi's' early movements: 
(a) Champaran Satyagraha (1917) was his first civil disobedience in India.
(b) Ahmedabad Mill Strike (1918) was his first hunger strike.
(c) Kheda Satyagraha (1918) was his first non-cooperation movement.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
These three local movements established Gandhi as a leader before he took up national issues like the Rowlatt Act and Khilafat.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
इन तीन स्थानीय आंदोलनों ने गांधी को राष्ट्रीय मुद्दों जैसे रॉलेट एक्ट और खिलाफत को उठाने से पहले एक नेता के रूप में स्थापित किया।

questions.question: The 'Ghadar Party' had its headquarters at:
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The headquarters was named 'Yugantar Ashram' and was located in San Francisco, USA.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मुख्यालय का नाम 'युगांतर आश्रम' था और यह सैन फ्रांसिस्को, अमेरिका में स्थित था।
